timezone.title: This device can't tell Phare what day it is
timezone.body: Phare works out which day — and so which month — a transaction belongs to using your household's time zone. This device's date formatting ignores the time zone it's given, so every date would be a guess.
timezone.consequence: Rather than book your money into the wrong month without telling you, Phare stops here.
timezone.whatToDo: Please send this screen to support@phare.money along with your device model and OS version.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
